title: Task
description: One unit of work. The contract fixes the interface; open_decisions is what is deliberately left to the implementer.

id.description: t-001, t-002, ... Never reused, never renumbered.

title.description: One line. Becomes the GitHub issue title.

contract.description: The interface. Fixed. An implementation that violates this is wrong regardless of how well it works.

inputs.description: What the code receives: call signature, file format, request shape.

outputs.description: What it must produce, precisely enough that two people would write the same type.

invariants.description: Properties that must hold after the change. Checkable statements, not aspirations.

must_not_break.description: Existing behaviour this task is forbidden to change.

open_decisions.description: Genuine choices left to the implementer. MUST be non-empty: a task whose contract fully determines the implementation is not a valid task for this experiment. This is the data the experiment exists to collect.

touched_paths.description: Glob patterns the implementation may write. A directory must be written as a glob: src/panel/** , not src/panel . Used for claim collision detection.

depends_on.description: Task ids that must be merged before this one can be claimed.

issue.description: GitHub issue number, or null if the issue could not be created.
